name: People Who Are Manipulating
overview: Scripture warns believers to remain vigilant against manipulation by false teachers and spiritual adversaries who seek to deceive even the elect through signs and wonders, as seen in Mark 13:22 and Ephesians 6:12. True security and protection come from dwelling in the presence of God, the Almighty (Psalms 91:1), and responding with a life wholly surrendered to Him as a living sacrifice (Romans 12:1). This calls Christians to spiritual discernment and steadfastness, recognizing that the battle is ultimately against unseen spiritual forces rather than mere human opposition.
